rationale: Revised plan addresses three evaluation feedback items. First, financial_summary.statistics changed from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to report median, p90, and p99 quantiles alongside sums and means, providing complete distribution characterization for the skewed financial amount columns. Second, write_report.show_denominators changed to true to display every rate as an explicit numerator / denominator = rate fraction, enhancing statistical transparency and reproducibility. Third, 'synthetic_data' caveat added to write_report.caveats alongside 'descriptive_only' to disclose that all findings are based on synthetic rather than production data. All other components and parameters remain unchanged to preserve comprehensive portfolio analysis.
changes_summary: Three parameter corrections: (1) financial_summary.statistics changed from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to include distribution quantiles (median, p90, p99) for skewed amount columns; (2) write_report.show_denominators changed from false to true to display rates with explicit numerator/denominator fractions; (3) write_report.caveats expanded from ['descriptive_only'] to ['descriptive_only', 'synthetic_data'] to disclose synthetic data basis.
